allow: PowerShell(Get-ChildItem "$env:USERPROFILE\\.claude" -Directory | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name; Write-Output "---"; Get-ChildItem "$env:USERPROFILE\\.claude" -File | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name)

PowerShell(Get-ChildItem "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\\claude-cli-nodejs" -Recurse -Depth 2 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object FullName, Length | Format-Table -AutoSize; Write-Output "---"; Get-ChildItem "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\\Programs" -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name)

PowerShell(Start-Sleep -Seconds 5; try { $tc = New-Object System.Net.Sockets.TcpClient; $tc.Connect\("127.0.0.1", 5000\); $stream = $tc.GetStream\(\); $bytes = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes\("VIDEO_READY|test.mp4`r`n"\); $stream.Write\($bytes, 0, $bytes.Length\); $stream.Flush\(\); Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500; $stream.Close\(\); $tc.Close\(\); "SUCCESS: sent $\($bytes.Length\) bytes" } catch { "FAILED: $_" })

PowerShell(try { $tc = New-Object System.Net.Sockets.TcpClient; $tc.Connect\("127.0.0.1", 1234\); $stream = $tc.GetStream\(\); $bytes = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes\("VIDEO_READY|test.mp4`r`n"\); $stream.Write\($bytes, 0, $bytes.Length\); $stream.Flush\(\); Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500; $stream.Close\(\); $tc.Close\(\); "SUCCESS: sent $\($bytes.Length\) bytes to 127.0.0.1:1234" } catch { "FAILED: $_" })
